_about: Measured medians from 447 studied reference shape elements (AE .aep parsed with py_aep, tools/import_aep.py). Numbers only — no vendor shapes, scripts or media are shipped. p10/p90 in brackets. influence in % (AE), times in s at 30 fps, widths in px at a 1100 px comp.

Arrows.features: triangle head rides a trace path (pointOnPath/tangentOnPath), round corners

Explosions.features: repeater 4/8 copies, trim, zigzag, twist, mixed polystars

Simple_Elements.features: filled polystars, merge subtract rings, pucker/bloat, gradient stroke

Simple_Elements_Looped.features: loopOut cycle, time*k rotation, repeater 12 copies

Slides.features: lines with End leading Start by ~0.17 s

Transitions.features: filled rect/ellipse wipes, zigzag edges, merge

Lower_Thirds.animators: Range Selector offset 0→100 % (square/ramp shapes) + track mattes

Titles.note: 194 title projects studied: text layers 729, shape 557; dominant effects Minimax/Set Matte/Drop Shadow/Venetian Blinds; text animators with per-character delay expressions (delay≈0.02-0.09 s × textIndex).
